observation.visible_scene: An outdoor dirt area with trees and a pole in the background. A man in a teal polo shirt and glasses crouches behind a metal wok/bowl on a small burner; the wok emits white smoke/vapor. He cradles a black motorcycle helmet with his left arm and gestures above the wok with a gray glove whose fingertips are green.
visible_changes: The right gloved hand is already above the wok at the start and moves during the excerpt: it shifts toward the viewer's left and upward, then back toward the wok/left side, with fingers opening from a curled position to spread.
White smoke/vapor rises continuously from the wok, changing shape, density, and lateral drift; it is an ongoing process throughout the clip.
The man's mouth and facial expression change repeatedly, indicating visible talking-like motion, but no audio is available.
The helmet remains held near the man's left side and shows little relative movement.
The background and overall framing are largely stable, with only slight apparent jitter/shift; the main visible motion is the hand and smoke.
outside_clip_unknowns: What is inside the wok and what produces the smoke.
Whether the hand is holding, dropping, or touching anything; no contact is visible.
The beginning and end of the gesture or speech before/after this cropped segment.
uncertain_details: Whether small changes in background position are camera movement or subject movement.
Whether the green fingertips are a glove color or a substance on the glove.
The exact 3D trajectory of the hand due to the 2D view.
